spindle.observe.AnswerSource.title: AnswerSource
spindle.observe.AnswerSource.description: What answered one external cause of a served command. `world`: the `decisions` of the world the last reset loaded, `spindle.console.World`. `file`: the decisions file. `default`: the default branch `--answer-default` takes. `unanswered`: nothing did, and the command answered `501`. Source: `crates/spindle-cli/src/decisions.rs:35-53`, `crates/spindle-ingress/src/observe.rs:186-209`.

spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.title: ExternalAnswer
spindle.observe.ExternalAnswer.description: One external cause a command asked about while a served request was answered, and what answered it.

command.description: The qualified command that asked: the routed command, or one an event binding invoked while the request was answered; the `command` label of `spindle_external_causes_total`.

outcome.description: The outcome whose cause was asked about, as the command declares it.

holds.description: Whether the cause holds; absent when nothing answered it.

spindle.observe.OperationKind.title: OperationKind
spindle.observe.OperationKind.description: What a routed request was for.

spindle.observe.RequestClass.title: RequestClass
spindle.observe.RequestClass.description: How a served run answered one request; the class follows who answered, not the status. `served`: the model answered it, with an outcome the command declares or the view's rows, whatever status the binding gives that outcome, `501` and `503` included. `refused`: the ingress or ESS's standard refusal answered it `4xx` before the model did, other than `not-granted`. `not-granted`: `403` "not granted", no grant admits the actor. `not-served`: spindle's own `501`, for an operation this ingress cannot route, the kernel does not run or the host does not read, or for an external cause nothing answered. `failed`: a `5xx` spindle itself answered, other than that `501`. `unrouted`: no route has the path, or not under that method.

spindle.observe.RequestRecord.title: RequestRecord
spindle.observe.RequestRecord.description: One request a served run answered, as `GET /__spindle/requests` lists it. Requests under `/__spindle/` are not recorded.

sequence.description: Monotonic per run, starting at 0; a gap in a list is a request the ring dropped.

at.description: When the request's head was read.

path.description: The request's path, without the query string.

route.description: The route template the path resolved to; absent for an unrouted request.

operation.description: The qualified command or view the route is bound to, or the console route as `GET /api/model`; absent for an unrouted request.

outcome.description: The outcome the model selected, for a command it answered.

reason.description: The `refused` text of the answer, as the caller received it, for every class but `served`.

duration_us.description: From the request's head read to its answer handed back, in microseconds.

events.description: The qualified names of the events the command published, in order.

externals.description: Every external cause asked while the request was answered, in the order asked: by the routed command and by every command an event binding invoked on the way.

unmet.description: Every event binding whose input was unmet while the request was answered, in the order the runtime reported them: bindings of the events the routed command published and of the events every command an event binding invoked on the way published. Empty when every binding's input was met. The list is complete when everything the request led to has run, and when it stopped because bindings kept triggering each other. When the routed command was kept and carrying its events on then failed, because the link to another component failed, a component's state could not be read or written, or another component stopped answering, the bindings found unmet before that failure are not listed.

spindle.observe.UnmetInput.title: UnmetInput
spindle.observe.UnmetInput.description: One event binding whose command input the event did not fill: a required field absent, or a value carried across a declared conversion that is no value of the input's type. The command is not invoked: zero attempts, no retry, and the event's other bindings still run; the command that published the event stays committed. ESS 0.90.0 calls this an unmet binding-input obligation, with no attempt and no policy, only for a binding whose failure policy is chosen per refusal, answers the same failure of every other binding unsupported, and defines no observable result for either (`crates/verify/ess-conformance/src/interpret/bindings.rs`). The rule for every binding and this answer are Spindle's (`docs/design/spindle.md` § 11, unmet binding input; `spindle_channel::Unmet`).

component.description: The component that accepts the command.

command.description: The qualified name of the command not invoked.

reason.description: Why the input could not be filled, as the runtime words it.
